objective: Build and prove controlled self-evolution: OBSERVATION -> HYPOTHESIS -> ISOLATED CANDIDATE -> EVALUATION -> INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION -> SHADOW -> CANARY -> PROMOTE OR REJECT -> MEASURE OUTCOME -> LEARN -> ROLLBACK/RESTORE WHEN NEEDED. A candidate may NEVER certify itself, promote itself, lower its risk classification, rewrite its acceptance criteria, widen its authority, increase its own budget, disable STOP, delete failed history, erase evidence, or control its own termination. Supervisor owns promotion/freeze/rollback/restore. Prove real durable cycles: at least 3 complete real evolution cycles; at least 2 measured successful promotions; at least 1 real R1 (low-risk) promotion; at least 1 bounded R2 promotion; at least 1 broken or non-improving candidate rejected; real rollback/restoration evidence; measured before/after outcomes; restart-safe cadence; honest WAITING when no useful improvement exists.

governed_proving_area.purpose: All evolution effects run in isolated proving stores under C:\Users\b\AppData\Local\Temp\jarvis-r11-*; candidates are real code/behavior changes evaluated against a real measured baseline in the isolated clone; no live daemon, database, vault, protected main, or owner project in place is touched.
governed_proving_area.privacy_boundary: Evidence records identities, hashes, timestamps, provenance, measured outcomes, and non-sensitive excerpts only; no credentials/secrets in evidence.
governed_proving_area.existing_machinery: Read-only imports from src/jarvis_foundry/evolution (records, registry, builder, lab, verify, shadow, canary, promote, restore, discover, cycle, acceptance) and supervisor/evolution_control.py where available; R11 adds a bounded additive proving harness + durable ledger lifecycle events; the R8 orchestration verify protocol and R4 kernel ledger are reused read-only.

mandatory_deliverables.item: Evolution lifecycle engine with Supervisor ownership
mandatory_deliverables.detail: Additive module(s) under src/jarvis_foundry/evolution_live/** implementing the full cycle with durable ledger events: OBSERVED -> HYPOTHESIZED -> CANDIDATE_ISOLATED -> EVALUATED -> INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED -> SHADOWED -> CANARY_READY -> PROMOTED or REJECTED -> OUTCOME_MEASURED -> LEARNED -> ROLLED_BACK/RESTORED; WAITING emitted honestly. Only the Supervisor identity can promote/freeze/rollback/restore; a candidate can never certify/promote/relax/erase/self-terminate.

At least 3 complete real cycles on real bounded code/behavior candidates in an isolated clone, with measured before/after outcomes (real test/behavior metrics), at least 2 measured successful promotions, at least 1 R1 promotion, at least 1 bounded R2 promotion, and at least 1 broken/non-improving candidate rejected with failed-history preserved.
Every candidate evaluation is verified by a fresh independent verifier (subprocess, no candidate context) before promotion; the verifier records verdict + evidence; self-certification impossible.
Real rollback/restoration evidence: a promoted candidate is rolled back and the prior release/baseline restored with before/after hashes; restore is independently proven.
Evolution state survives simulated restart with no duplicate effects; when no useful improvement exists, an honest WAITING record is emitted (never busy-work).

Per-cycle evidence: observation, hypothesis, candidate diff, evaluation metrics, verifier verdict, promotion/rejection decision, before/after measurement, rollback/restore hashes, and the exact next autonomous action.

At least 1 broken or non-improving candidate rejected with failed-history preserved (never deleted).
Independent verification: no candidate certifies/promotes itself; a fresh verifier reproduces every cycle and the rollback/restore.

Real rollback/restoration evidence with before/after hashes; Supervisor owns promotion/freeze/rollback/restore; candidates cannot widen authority/increase budget/disable STOP/erase evidence/control termination (probes prove each refusal).
Restart-safe cadence proven (no duplicate effects); full repo suite green; static clean; no protected mutation; evidence under 8 MiB.
